0022600161.text: The Knicks (2-4, 1-2 at home, and 4th in the Atlantic, 3 games back) host the Brooklyn Nets (0-5, on a five-game losing streak and 15th in the East) for New York's seventh game of the 2026-27 season. Jose Alvarado is out for the Knicks with an ankle sprain, and the Nets are missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 4-0, most recently taking a 93-92 win in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026.
